description.value:
Patience as a weapon. You find the vantage, and by the time anyone notices you are there the shot has already landed. Everyone else is fighting a room. You are fighting a line.

SIGNATURE — Distance is your advantage, not your penalty — the further out they are, the worse it goes for them.

cinderfall.incomplete: Zero-number level-1 Draw-signature flavor grant. No numeric follow-through exists anywhere else on this Draw's own card family -- a genuine content gap, not a search failure.
